results.title: Fall 2026: Nepal: Himalayan and Buddhist Peoples | SIT Study Abroad
results.content: # Nepal. ### Himalayan and Buddhist Peoples. Home » Programs » Nepal » **Fall 2026: Nepal: Himalayan and Buddhist Peoples**. Learn about Himalayan peoples, cultures, and religions in the vibrant and dynamic nation of Nepal. #### Language of Study. Learn about the development of Buddhism, born in Nepal, and its deep cultural roots and connections to ancient pilgrimage routes and sacred sites. Spend six weeks in Kathmandu, Nepal’s capital, in the neighborhood of Boudha, centered around the world heritage Boudhanath Stupa and home to a significant high Himalayan Buddhist community. Take a high-altitude trek to learn from mountain communities about the complexities of language and identity in the borderlands. Sample topic areas: the politics of language and education in Himalayan communities; youth identity in the Himalayan diaspora; traditional Himalayan medicine; the reemergence of the Bön tradition; Tibetan Muslims; the economics of the Tibetan carpet industry in Nepal; the economy of Sherpas and mountaineering tourism; a case study of a traditional Buddhist college; nuns and Tibetan female mystics; and the changing status of women in Buddhist monastic life.
